topic.name: Solving Quadratic Equations With Complex Roots

question.explanation:
First, we write the equation in standard form by bringing all of the terms to the left-hand side. This gives the equation \[ x^2+2x+5=0. \]

We can find the roots of a quadratic equation using the quadratic formula: \[ x = \frac{-b\pm\sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a} \]

In this case, the coefficients are $a=1, \,b=2,$ and $ c=5.$ Substituting these values into the quadratic formula, we get \begin{align*} x &= \frac{-2\pm\sqrt{2^2-4(1)(5)}}{2(1)}\\[5pt] &= \frac{-2\pm\sqrt{4-20}}{2} \\[5pt] &= \frac{-2\pm\sqrt{-16}}{2} \\[5pt] &= \frac{-2 \pm 4\,\textrm{i}}{2} \\[5pt] &= -1\pm 2\,\textrm{i}. \end{align*}

Therefore, the equation has two solutions, $x=-1+2\,\textrm{i}$ and $x=-1-2\,\textrm{i}.$

question.text: What are the solutions of the equation $(x+3)^2 = -4?$
question.explanation:
The left-hand side is a perfect square. Therefore, we can solve the equation using the square root method:

\begin{align*} (x+3)^2 &= -4\\[5pt] x+3 &= \pm\sqrt{-4}\\[5pt] x+3 &= \pm 2\,\textrm{i}\\[5pt] x &=-3 \pm 2\,\textrm{i} \end{align*}

Therefore, the equation has two solutions, $x=-3+2\,\textrm{i}$ and $x=-3-2\,\textrm{i}.$

example.title: Solving a Quadratic Equation With Complex Roots by Completing the Square

question.explanation:
First, we write the equation in standard form by bringing all of the terms to the left-hand side. This gives the equation \[ x^2-2x+50=0. \]

We can find the roots of a quadratic equation using the quadratic formula: \[ x = \frac{-b\pm\sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a} \]

In this case, the coefficients are $a=1, \,b=-2,$ and $c=50.$ Substituting these values into the quadratic formula, we get \begin{align*} x &= \frac{-(-2)\pm\sqrt{(-2)^2-4(1)(50)}}{2(1)}\\[5pt] &= \frac{2\pm\sqrt{4-200}}{2}\\[5pt] &= \frac{2\pm\sqrt{-196}}{2}\\[5pt] &= \frac{2 \pm 14\,\textrm{i}}{2}\\[5pt] &= \bbox[4pt,border: 1px solid lightgray]{1} \pm \bbox[4pt,border: 1px solid lightgray]{7}\,\textrm{i}. \end{align*}

Therefore, the equation has two solutions, $x=1+7\,\textrm{i}$ and $x=1-7\,\textrm{i}.$
